static_traits.name: 杨安
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友与邻居等社会支持，但尚not yet向他们倾诉当前困扰；与配偶关系因自责与易怒出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往相似心理问题与心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高，能Reflection自身思维模式；存在明显的“应该”句式与自我批评；初始紧张但态度积极，愿意尝试重构与练习

basic_info.main_problem: 在最近一次瑜伽课因一个动作not做到而感到尴尬与not足，反复回想该情境并产生回避再次上课的念头；同时在农事上因玉米长势not如Anticipation而自我贬低，频繁以“我应该更好/我not胜任”等念头评判自己，影响作息、情绪与人际。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望处理瑜伽课后的尴尬与Self-doubt，not让这些感受左右生活方式与日常选择，并通过现实检验与重构思维获得更平衡的看法。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent
只有表现完美才说明我有价值

special_situations.event: 上一节瑜伽课中，一个动作做not到而其他人都能做到
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像do not人一样做到动作，就说明我not行，会被看低与嘲笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避再次去瑜伽课以避免尴尬与他人评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我再也not要去瑜伽课了；大家一定觉得我很糟糕

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking about attending the next yoga class or similar situations where failure may occur again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再次失败，do not人都会注意到并评判我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前Withdrawal与回避，减少暴露在可能失败的情境中
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我肯定会再次出丑，去了也只会更难堪

special_situations.event: 看到邻居的庄稼收成Good而自己的玉米长势not佳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的作物not如邻居，就证明我是个糟糕的Farmer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断更换肥料、向他人请教但同时自我贴标签、苛责自己

special_situations.event: 检查作物时发现生长not佳，联想到自己的责任与表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该早就知道怎么做且not该犯错误，否则就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to improve through self-criticism and raising standards, while ignoring existing efforts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更好/我应该早就想到这个办法

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, proving oneself to be a capable and worthy person
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因not完美或失败而被羞辱、被negate、被比较后显得not如人
defense_goal: 通过回避可能暴露not足的情境以降低羞耻与被评判的风险
以自我批评和高标准来控制Anxiety并维持对价值感的掌控

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易失败、让人失望的自己
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者/轻松成功的他人（同学、邻居）
被自己情绪影响、可能失望的伴侣

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing in counseling expressing one's own failures and feelings to others (friends, neighbors, or spouse)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心他人会视自己为without能者或因此失望
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责性表述为主（如“It is all my fault”），语气压低、减少情感外放，避免直接表达对他人的not满与失望。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 想到再次去瑜伽课或面临可能失败的公开场合
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会注意并嘲笑自己的not足（他人充满负面评价）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 含蓄表达对他人评判的担心，use模糊化语言（如“大家都会觉得……”），降低自我暴露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当觉察到大量“应该/必须”自我要求时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把外界标准not yet经消化地当作自我价值的唯一依据
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use规范化、绝对化的语句（如“我必须、我应该”），语气严苛克制，减少情感词汇。

manifestations: 以僵化的“应该/必须”标准约束自我，难以容许not完美与犯错
面对可能失败的情境选择回避（如not再去瑜伽课），以减少被评判风险
outcomes: 内疚与Increased anxiety，体验到自我压迫与失去选择的Freedom
Sleep impaired、Decreased drive、生活范围缩小

manifestations: 明知有朋友与邻居的支持，却not yet向他们倾诉当前困扰
与配偶关系因自责与易怒而疏离
outcomes: 社会支持not yet被激活，Increased subjective sense of isolation
Increased emotional burden、负性自我评价持续

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁出现“我应该/必须更好”的自我要求
将完美表现视为自我价值的必要条件

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 面对not如意与比较时，将not满与挫败转为自责和自我攻击
not向他人求助与表达，而是Repression情绪、独自承受

positive_force: Has genuine interest and investment in activities such as yoga, and long enjoyed the classes
Has a tendency to seek help and try to improve (changing fertilizer, asking neighbors for advice)
Has some awareness of cognitive distortions, willing to do reality testing and restructuring
存在可用的社会支持资源（朋友、邻居、配偶）
Positive attitude toward counseling, with a sense of hope and action plans (recording restructuring, gratitude practice)
negative_force: 完美主义与僵化的“应该”规则主导自我评价
过度概括、心理过滤、negate积极面的认知方式
社会比较敏感，依赖外部评价以确认自我价值
回避潜在失败情境（如not再去瑜伽课），导致体验与能力受限
自责与内疚加重情绪负担，影响睡眠与人际

antecedent: 想到要参加下一次瑜伽课
回想上一次在课堂上做not到动作、他人都能做到的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 在完美主义标准下对失败/尴尬的灾难化Anticipation与对他人评判的恐惧
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的事物（羞耻与被评判），暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 每周惯例被打乱，兴趣活动减少，负性情绪维持并ReinforcementSelf-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-criticism and 'should'-style self-blame (such as 'I should be better/I should have known earlier')
antecedent: 检查作物时发现长势not佳
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外界标准Introjection为自我价值评判基础，并在社会比较中将失利等同于“我not行”
target_behavior.function: Obtaining a sense of control and self-drive through self-attack, trying to avoid facing vulnerability and the need to seek help
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、与配偶Relationship tension、Sleep difficulties、工作Decreased drive
